against_battery.miscalibration: EVIDENCE AGAINST if, for ANY width with >= min_informative_items informative items, the stream has >= against_min_days matured freeze days, |gap| >= against_min_abs_gap, and the against_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap excludes 0. gap > 0 = bands broke MORE often than forecast.

fixed_rule.cadence: One verdict every 28 days on the CUMULATIVE matured record since the first freeze. Earlier verdicts are never revised.
calibrated_conditions_all_required: for EVERY width with >= min_informative_items informative items: the calibrated_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap lies entirely inside [-calibration_tolerance, +calibration_tolerance]
at least one width saw both outcomes among its informative items
fixed_rule.evaluation_order: INVALID first; then EVIDENCE AGAINST; then CALIBRATED; else UNTESTED. The first that fires decides.
fixed_rule.forecast_object: p = P(the band is left within 14 days) for a fresh position +/-5%, +/-15%, +/-35% around the pool's own price, snapped OUTWARD to the pool's tick spacing, for every pool in sui_v2/universe.json (Cetus and Turbos CLMM pools on Sui, fixed at seal; the file's sha256 is in every row). Frozen once per UTC day at 12:00 UTC from the latest collector sample (<= 30 min old). Three labelled models: SV-B1 = the asset's Coinbase daily candles (SUI, DEEP, WAL, ETH); SV-B1-x = SUI-quoted cross pools, the daily ratio series of the two legs built from hourly closes (slightly understates intraday extremes); SV-B1-own = pools with no candle series, built from this collector's own daily closes. A pool is forecast only once it has 60 usable 14-day windows; until then it is published as 'collecting history' and receives no number.
invalid_battery: any frozen row created after its window opened (window_start_ts != created_at_ts) or whose entry sample is more than 1800 s older than created_at_ts
a matured row is INCOMPLETE when its window has < 90% of the expected ~10-minute samples; INCOMPLETE rows exceeding incomplete_max_share of the stream's matured rows make the verdict INVALID
the stream froze on fewer than running_min_share of the calendar days in the judged period
any row whose prediction_hash does not recompute from its own fields
fixed_rule.outcome: breach = 1 if ANY collector sample (one per ~10 minutes) with created_at_ts <= ts < created_at_ts + 14 d has tick < band_tick_lower OR tick >= band_tick_upper. 10-minute sampling can miss a brief excursion; that bias favours 'no breach' and is accepted, not corrected. Recomputed at grade time from the stored samples.

protocol_constants.gap_definition: gap(width) = mean over resolved items of (breach - p)
protocol_constants.informative_item: an item with 0.02 <= p <= 0.98 (near-certain forecasts are excluded from the tests but shown in the reliability table)

reported_not_gated: Brier and Brier skill vs climatology per width
gaps split BY MODEL (SV-B1 / SV-B1-x / SV-B1-own) — this is how the cross-pool and own-history labels get tested
fee_14d_est, exp_il and FIR are displayed economics and are NOT graded by this standard
fixed_rule.serial_dependence: Daily 14-day windows overlap and Sui pools move with SUI, so rows are NOT independent. All inference resamples whole freeze DAYS in moving blocks of 14 consecutive days (2000 resamples, seed 42).

notes: Seal BEFORE the first sui-v2.0.0 freeze. Spec: docs/design/SUI_V2_SPEC.md. SUI v1's tick-level collector was retired for cost; this version reads one Move object per pool every 10 minutes (about 0.5 MB/day for the whole set) and nothing else.
one_line_commitment: Every day, for every covered Sui CLMM pool and three band widths, a probability that price leaves the band within 14 days is frozen before the window opens; the cumulative record is judged mechanically on calibration, and every result is published including misses.
status: STANDING STANDARD (SUI v2 / probability-of-breach family) - COMMITTED. Governs every sui-v2.0.0 forecast. Sealed before the first freeze.
